models.name: Seedance 2.5
models.description: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's AI video generation model, notable for native audio and voice generation in a single pass. Within days of release it became the fastest-adopted video model of mid-2026: Hedra, Leonardo, Higgsfield, Pika, Runway and fal.ai all announced integrations between late July and early August 2026.
models.highlight: Adopted by at least 6 major platforms (Hedra, Leonardo, Higgsfield, Pika, Runway, fal.ai) within two weeks of release.

models.name: Seedream 5.0
models.description: Seedream 5.0 is ByteDance's image generation model family. The Pro variant reached third-party platforms in July 2026, starting with Recraft Studio, and the family is offered alongside Seedance on fal.ai's enterprise platform.
models.highlight: Available in Recraft Studio and on fal.ai's enterprise platform.

models.name: FLUX 3
models.description: FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' multimodal generation model spanning image, video and audio, released on July 23, 2026. It marked BFL's expansion beyond still images into a unified multimodal family, and reached third-party access via Pika's API Club in early August 2026.
models.highlight: BFL's first unified image + video + audio model.

models.name: FLUX 3 Video
models.description: FLUX 3 Video is Black Forest Labs' video generation model, released August 4, 2026 with native audio generation and multi-language support. It generates video with sound in a single pass — no separate audio step — and landed in Leonardo within days of release.
models.highlight: Native audio generation in a single pass, multi-language support.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 & Qwen 3.8-Max
models.description: Qwen 3.8 is Alibaba's flagship large language model, launched July 19, 2026 with 2.4 trillion parameters and a commitment to open weights. Qwen 3.8-Max, released August 3, 2026, is described by Alibaba as its most capable model yet — ranking #5 on the AI Index, #1 on the Agentic Index, and #2 in the Image-to-WebDev Arena, at a lower cost than its predecessors.
models.highlight: 2.4T parameters; Max variant ranks #1 on the Agentic Index.

models.name: Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro
models.description: Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro is Alibaba's flagship image generation model, ranked #5 globally per Alibaba's August 2026 announcement. It became available on Qwen Cloud on August 5, 2026.
models.highlight: Ranks #5 globally among image models per Alibaba.

models.name: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS
models.description: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS is Alibaba's text-to-speech model, introduced July 23, 2026 with both real-time and high-quality synthesis options.

models.name: Wan 3.0
models.description: Wan 3.0 is Alibaba's video generation model. In August 2026 the Wan team showed it transforming full creative briefs into finished video campaigns, positioning it as an end-to-end ad/campaign generation tool rather than a clip generator.
models.highlight: Turns creative briefs into complete video campaigns.

models.name: Wan-Dancer-14B
models.description: Wan-Dancer-14B is an open-source 14B-parameter dance/motion video model from Alibaba's Wan team, released July 14, 2026.

models.name: AnimeGen
models.description: AnimeGen is an anime-focused video generation model from Alibaba's Wan team, announced July 21, 2026.

models.name: GPT-5.6 (Sol · Luna · Terra)
models.description: GPT-5.6 is OpenAI's frontier model family with three variants: Sol, Luna and Terra. In August 2026 OpenAI shipped rapid updates — Sol improved factuality by 68% in high-stakes domains, Luna gained extended thinking for Free and Go users, and Luna prices were cut by 80% (Terra by 20%) at the end of July 2026.
models.highlight: Sol +68% factuality; Luna prices cut 80% in July 2026.

models.name: Midjourney V8.2
models.description: Midjourney V8.2 is Midjourney's image generation model, released July 24, 2026 with improved aesthetics and deeper personalization.

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.description: MiniMax H3 is MiniMax's flagship model. Through late July and early August 2026 it spread across creative platforms — available on Leonardo, in Luma Agents, and via Pika's API Club.
models.highlight: Available on Leonardo, Luma Agents and Pika API Club.

models.name: MiniMax open-weight video model
models.description: MiniMax (Hailuo AI) released an open-weight video generation model on August 3, 2026, joining the mid-2026 wave of Chinese labs open-sourcing video models.

models.name: Tencent Hy3 (Hunyuan 3)
models.description: Hy3 is Tencent Hunyuan's flagship 295B-parameter language model. In July 2026 it claimed the top spot on the OpenRouter LLM leaderboard, shipped 1-bit and 4-bit quantized versions, was used in additive combinatorics research, and powers Tencent's Hy3 agent workspace in WorkBuddy, which launched globally in August 2026.
models.highlight: 295B parameters; topped the OpenRouter leaderboard in July 2026.

models.name: Hy ASR 3.0
models.description: Hy ASR 3.0 is Tencent Hunyuan's speech recognition model, launched in preview August 4, 2026 with improved semantic understanding.

models.name: Hy-MT2
models.description: Hy-MT2 is Tencent Hunyuan's machine translation model. By end of July 2026 it passed 700K downloads and ranked #1 trending on Hugging Face.

models.name: Hyra-1.0 (Hunyuan Research Agent)
models.description: Hyra-1.0 is Tencent's Hunyuan Research Agent, launched July 21, 2026 for autonomous research workflows.

models.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash & 3.5 Flash-Lite
models.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite are Google's fast/efficient model tier, released July 21, 2026.

models.name: Gemini Robotics 2
models.description: Gemini Robotics 2 is Google DeepMind's robotics foundation model, announced July 30, 2026, bringing full-body intelligence to humanoid robots.

models.name: WeatherNext
models.description: WeatherNext is Google DeepMind's weather forecasting model. In August 2026 it achieved state-of-the-art cyclone forecasting accuracy.

models.name: Ideogram 4.0
models.description: Ideogram 4.0 is Ideogram's image generation model. In July 2026 Ideogram partnered with AMD for scaled deployment of the model.

models.name: Ideogram P-Image
models.description: P-Image is Ideogram's model line launched July 30, 2026, tuned for quality-speed-cost trade-offs. The related Object Remover tool topped the RemovalBench benchmark the same week.

models.name: Synthesia Dubbing 2.0
models.description: Dubbing 2.0 is Synthesia's video dubbing model, rolled out through July 2026 with voice preservation, improved lip sync, expressive voices, and support for 130+ languages.

models.name: VEED Lip Sync 2.0
models.description: VEED Lip Sync 2.0 is Veed's lip synchronization model, launched with an API on July 14, 2026.

models.name: OpenEdit
models.description: OpenEdit is Veed's open-source agentic video editor, launched August 4, 2026.

models.name: Bria V-RMBG 3.0
models.description: V-RMBG 3.0 is Bria AI's video background removal model, launched July 23, 2026 as a plugin for OBS.

models.name: Higgsfield open models (Hell Grind · Zephyr · Mork)
models.description: Hell Grind, Zephyr and Mork are three models Higgsfield open-sourced on August 3, 2026, part of the mid-2026 open-weights wave in AI video.
